newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-VFB STUTTGART STORM TO TOP OF BUNDESLIGA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VFB STUTTGART STORM TO TOP OF BUNDESLIGA.

text.p: VfB Stuttgart stepped up their championship challenge when they humbled Fortuna Duesseldorf 4-0 away on Friday to move top of the Bundesliga.
With four second half goals, Stuttgart leap-frogged Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich to open a one-point gap over their main rivals who have a match in hand.
Stuttgart have been in superb form in the past week, drubbing European Cup semifinalists Dortmund 4-1 last Saturday.
Bulgarian Krassimir Balakov opened the scoring in the 48th minute and Matthias Hagner hit the second eight minutes later.
Fredi Bobic netted in the 64th minute and Giovane Elber headed his team's fourth two minutes from time.
Stuttgart coach Joachim Loew criticised his team for being "sluggish" in the first half, but praised their performance in the second.
"In the second half they did much better," said Loew. "Now we can sit back and watch tomorrow's games in a relaxed way."
Dortmund host lowly Borussia Moenchengladbach on Saturday and Bayern travel to Karlsruhe on Sunday.
